title: Charlie Wylie leads Horned Frogs with career-best round in Japan tournament
text:
Charlie Wylie leads Horned Frogs with career-best round in Japan tournament
Junior Charlie Wylie opened the season with a career-best 6-under 65 to lead the Horned Frogs in the first round of the Pan Pacific University Super League Tournament on Sep. 2 in Shizuoka, Japan.
Wylie began his round with an eagle on the first hole, a par 5, and followed up with four birdies for a front nine score of 31. He added another birdie on the back nine to finish at 34.
Toby Wilt also finished in the top ten after shooting a 4-under 67, placing him in a tie for sixth place. Sophomores Nathan Miller and Sam Udovich are both within the top twenty; Miller shot a 2-under 69 to tie for eleventh place, while Udovich carded a 1-under 70 and is tied for fifteenth place.
Freshman Cameron Kuchar made his collegiate debut with a score of three-over-par (74), putting him in a tie for thirty-eighth position. The Horned Frogs as a team are currently second after recording an opening-round total of thirteen-under-par (271). Nihon University from Tokyo holds first place with sixteen-under-par (268).
The Pan Pacific University Super League Tournament features both Japanese and American universities, including twelve women's teams. TCU will begin its second round Thursday morning at 9:30 local time in Japan, which corresponds to Wednesday at 7:30 p.m. Central Time.
